description: Change, add or remove a Render Queue item's output module (Output Module Settings dialog, Composition > Add Output Module): template or output format (QuickTime, AVI, H.264, image sequences such as PNG, TIFF, JPEG, OpenEXR, DPX, Targa, Photoshop, SGI, IFF, Radiance, or audio as AIFF, MP3, WAV), output file and file name template, channels, depth, colour, starting frame number, resize, crop, audio output, project link, source XMP metadata and post-render action, and optionally save it as a template. Codecs such as GoPro CineForm are chosen through a template made in Edit > Templates > Output Module

add.description: Add a new output module to the item and change that one (Composition > Add Output Module). Default false

crop.description: Crop pixels from the edges (negative values add pixels)

enabled.description: false turns cropping off. Default true

depth.description: "Depth", e.g. Millions of Colors, Millions of Colors+, Trillions of Colors, Floating Point

fileTemplate.description: File name template from the Output To menu, e.g. "[compName]_[#####].[fileExtension]"

format.description: Output format: applies the first output module template that writes it

includeProjectLink.description: Embed a link back to the After Effects project

includeSourceXmp.description: Copy XMP metadata from the source footage into the output

outputFile.description: Absolute output path. For image sequences include frame-number signs, e.g. frame_[#####].png

outputModule.description: 1-based output module of the item. Default 1

postRenderAction.description: After rendering: nothing, import the file, import it and replace the composition's uses, or set it as the composition's proxy

remove.description: Remove the output module (the item keeps at least one). Default false

enabled.description: false turns resizing off. Default true

saveAsTemplate.description: Save the resulting output module as a template with this name

settings.description: Any other settings by the English name After Effects gives them (get_render_item shows the settable names and current values), e.g. { "Quality": "Best" }

startingNumber.description: First frame number of an image sequence ("Starting #"); turns off Use Comp Frame Number

template.description: Output module template, e.g. "High Quality", "Lossless", "H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps" (list_render_templates lists them)

useCompFrameNumber.description: Number sequence frames from the composition's frame numbers

name: set_output_module
title: Set Output Module
